dyadic_chain_definitions.Delta_Hcal_Y: Hcal_Y(m, n) - Hcal_Y(2*m, n) - Hcal_Y(m, 2*n) + Hcal_Y(2*m, 2*n)
dyadic_chain_definitions.Kcal_Y: sum_{j in J_u(T), k in J_v(T)} Delta_Hcal_Y(4^j * u, 4^k * v)
dyadic_chain_definitions.Sigma_off_p2: sum_{m != n in I_2(T)} lambda(m)*lambda(n)*Delta_Hcal_Y(m, n)
dyadic_chain_definitions.S_same_Y: sum_{u in O(T)} sum_{j != k in J_u(T)} Delta_Hcal_Y(4^j * u, 4^k * u)
dyadic_chain_definitions.S_different_Y: sum_{u != v in O(T)} lambda(u)*lambda(v)*Kcal_Y(u, v)
dyadic_chain_definitions.D_tilde_Y: inherited grouped prime-power diagonal (sum over multiples q^a | n BEFORE squaring)
